title: Visual Foresight for Agentic Reasoning Before Action in Urban Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.04916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Urban navigation requires embodied agents to pursue long-horizon goals through local decisions based on egocentric observations. However, existing agentic navigation methods often struggle to translate distant goals into coherent local decisions. Their reliance on linguistic reasoning over transient observations or limited history constrains anticipation of action consequences, despite the importance of such foresight for navigating long and complex urban routes. To bridge this gap, we propose PreAct-Nav, a training-free agentic navigation framework that equips frozen policies with visual foresight for reasoning before action. Our central idea is to use predicted future views to assess proposed actions in the context of persistent medium-horizon subgoals and observed experience. At its core, a navigation memory module maintains the active subgoal and relevant experience across decisions, translating distant goals into actionabl

translated_title: 城市导航中行动前智能体推理的视觉前瞻方法
translated_abstract: 城市导航要求具身智能体基于自我中心的观测，通过局部决策来追求长期目标。然而，现有的智能体导航方法往往难以将遥远的目标转化为连贯的局部决策。这些方法依赖于对瞬态观测或有限历史信息的语言推理，限制了对行动后果的预判能力，而这种前瞻能力对于在漫长而复杂的城市路线中导航至关重要。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了PreAct-Nav，这是一个无需训练的智能体导航框架，它为冻结的策略配备视觉前瞻能力，以在行动之前进行推理。其核心思想是利用预测的未来视图，在持续的中等时程子目标和观测经验的背景下评估所提出的行动。该框架的核心是一个导航记忆模块，它在多次决策之间维护当前活跃的子目标及相关经验，将遥远的目标转化为可执行的（局部决策）。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的智能体导航框架PreAct-Nav，通过视觉前瞻（预测未来视图）和导航记忆模块，使冻结的策略能够在行动前进行推理，从而将遥远的长期目标转化为连贯的局部决策。
en_tdlr: PreAct-Nav is a training-free agentic navigation framework that equips frozen policies with visual foresight—using predicted future views and a navigation memory module—to reason before acting, translating distant long-horizon goals into coherent local decisions.
